reason_for_revision: R3 export could perform hundreds of synchronous full-thread reads on the WinForms GUI thread. R4 pumps UI events during network waits, exposes progress and cancellation, prevents export re-entry, and records typed Horizon stop causes without reintroducing a fixed attempt cap.
authority_boundary: This receipt establishes public presence and field consistency in COM. It does not authenticate the package independently of the repository/human authority, and does not claim release, production, promotion or validation.
